title: Flags (staff)
body:
Syntax: rset flags <flagname>  (room flags -- toggle)
        oset <vnum> flags <flagname>  (item flags -- prefix - to remove)
        mset <vnum> flags <flagname>  (mob flags -- prefix - to remove)

Description: Only a recognized flag can be set on any of the three -- an unknown name (including a typo) is refused outright, telling you the valid list. Matching is case-insensitive; whichever way you type a valid flag, it's stored under its one correct/canonical casing shown below, so it's always recognized correctly by whatever system actually checks for it.

&WRoom flags:&x
  CapturePoint       -- makes this room a war/territory control point; see 'help territory'
  accelerated_healing -- faster regen in this room (set automatically on every hospital; rarely needs setting by hand)

&WItem flags:&x
  no_sac             -- protects this item from being destroyed by 'sacrifice', including 'sacrifice all'
  no_take            -- protects this item from being picked up with 'get' at all -- for cosmetic room decoration (furniture, signs, plants) placed via 'oset load' or a registered spawn point, meant to stay exactly where it's put

&WMob flags:&x
  Banker             -- lets a player 'bank'/'bank deposit'/'bank withdraw' at this mob
  BountyOffice       -- lets a player claim a bounty in person at this mob
  Wander             -- gives this mob a small per-tick chance to move through a random available exit (moves roughly every few minutes, not constantly; never into an apartment room)
  Sentinel           -- a hard override blocking wander behavior for this mob, even if Wander is also set
  Garrison           -- war/territory defender designation; set automatically and accurately on every garrison mob, see 'help territory'
  Trap               -- war/territory trap designation; set automatically and accurately on every trap mob, see 'help trap'
  Npc                -- base flag every non-player mob carries; a pure category label, no mechanical effect of its own by design
  Shopkeeper         -- the real shop mechanism is a separate field set elsewhere; this flag alone has no mechanical check

Date: 2026-08-17
